info.title: GoWay API
info.summary: Oxy's open map platform: Places, capability filters, search, geocoding, routing and Street 3D.
info.description: Generated from `packages/contracts` — the zod schemas the API validates with and `@goway.to/sdk` parses with. Success bodies are the contract value with no envelope; every error is `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details"? } }`; every list is `{ "items", "nextCursor" }` with an opaque cursor bound to its filters.

openingHoursDays.description: Atomic replacements of unique opening weekdays (0 Sunday to 6 Saturday). Empty intervals close a day. Omitted days remain unchanged. Mutually exclusive with openingHours. Unknown schedules require all seven days, otherwise conflict. The resulting week may contain at most 64 intervals.

oxySession.description: An Oxy access token (`aud=oxy-api`), as `@oxy.so/services` issues it.
